profile.headline: Big Data & Streaming Engineer | Data Engineer | Analytics Platform Engineer | Kafka | Cloud (Azure | AWS | GCP)
profile.summary:
I am a Senior Data Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing and building large-scale data platforms, real-time streaming applications, and cloud-native solutions for enterprise environments, including the banking and financial services industry.
My expertise lies in architecting high-throughput data pipelines, distributed systems, and event-driven architectures using Apache Kafka, Java, Spring Boot, Azure, and modern cloud technologies. Throughout my career, I have successfully delivered solutions that process millions of transactions, support mission-critical workloads, and enable scalable, secure, and reliable data movement across enterprise ecosystems

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer II – Data Engineering
Sr. Software Engineer II – Data Engineering
positions.description: Develop high-volume streaming applications in Java using the Kafka API, ingesting data from multiple enterprise source systems and serving 1M+ customer accounts. Design and manage batch and event-driven data pipelines that synchronize Spring Boot batch processes with real-time Java and Kafka streaming applications, increasing throughput through parallel processing. Build self-service automation for the Kafka platform, provisioning topics and RBAC bindings through shell scripting and GitLab webhook integrations to remove manual platform involvement for internal teams. Use GitHub Copilot in day-to-day development to accelerate delivery and improve code quality, including implementing Prometheus instrumentation to export application metrics into Datadog. Orchestrate multi-region migration of real-time streaming services from on-premises Kubernetes to Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS) via Terraform and GitLab CI/CD, shortening deployment cycle times and achieving zero-downtime releases. Apply schema validation, field-level encryption, and RBAC policies across 500+ Kafka topics, enforcing data governance for downstream analytics teams. Manage a 24-broker Kafka infrastructure across two 12-node clusters in separate datacenters, tuning high-throughput topics and partitioning to sustain peak volume without loss of availability. Execute disaster recovery and failover testing across datacenter clusters, validating cross-site replication and client failover for business continuity. Perform capacity planning and performance tuning for Kafka clusters, forecasting broker, storage, and partition growth ahead of demand. Author design documents, runbooks, and onboarding guides that enable internal teams to self-serve platform services. Design and implement load balancing across Azure and on-premises environments to manage client traffic to Kafka clusters.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer II – Data Engineering
Software Engineer
positions.description: Participated in developing ETL microservices using Java, Spring Boot, and the Kafka API to extract customer and student data from multiple SQL database tables, transform it into a standardized format, and load it into a centralized Cassandra database. Worked with customer and student data spread across multiple source tables, consolidating it into a unified Cassandra data store for downstream consumption. Collaborated with the team to create Kafka topics and Hive tables to support data ingestion and processing pipelines. Participated in deploying Spring Boot microservices to Kubernetes, using Jenkins to automate build and deployment.
